verdict.rationale: The evidence covers org-wide service connections, scoped access grants, and credential rotation for Sprites, plus encrypted app secrets. None of it describes integrating an organization's identity provider (SSO, OIDC, or SAML) to secure internal apps, deployments, or agents. These are adjacent credential-management features, not IdP-based access control, so for this applicable axis the verdict is none.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can secure internal apps, deployments, and agents using my organization's identity provider
